change_summary: Approved targeted corpus change set. 21 mandatory wording corrections applied as minimal clause-level edits (all 21 CHANGED, 0 already present, 0 unmapped); 65 approved non-destructive display segmentations totalling 180 display units; 4 cross-record continuity operations; the 3 expressly excluded stylistic constructions left untouched. Segmentation is presentational only: canonical record ids, order and text are unchanged and each record's segment slices concatenate back to its canonical text exactly, so notes, highlights, favourites and saved positions keep resolving through the canonical parent id. Speech offsets were recalculated by exact delta for the 7 affected records. CORPUS and SPEECH_DATA change by design, so the v101.44 protected-declaration contract is re-baselined at v101.52 rather than dropped.
